=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:425-461 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_DETAIL_FIELDS` selects `timelineItems(last: 40, ...)` and `comments(last: 5)` directly on the `IssueOrPullRequest` union with no `... on Issue` / `... on PullRequest` fragment, and `MERGED_EVENT` is a PullRequest-only timeline item type, so GitHub rejects every detail query.
  WHY: Every `fetch_details` batch raises `ApiError`, every repository with candidates becomes `read_failed`, `classify` skips them, and cursors do not advance until they are clamped after `ISSUE_PR_AUDIT_MAX_WINDOW_DAYS`. `FakeTransport.graphql` never validates the query, so the tests pass anyway. All five reviewers agree on BLOCKER, or the equivalent where no severity was stated.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:416-421 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `list_open()` never checks `has_issues` and always calls `repos/{r}/issues?state=open`, which returns 410 for repositories with issues disabled but open PRs (`open_issues_count` > 0).
  WHY: The `ApiError` from the 410 makes `collect()` mark the repository `read_failed` and discard its window listing on every run, so the repository's cursor never advances and it is never audited.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:416-420, 882-913 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `list_open()` throws away the `truncated` flag from `paginate` (5-page / 500-item cap), and `classify()` rebuilds `next_state["blocked"]` only from the returned snapshot.
  WHY: Old blocked items past the cap are never listed, and known blocked entries are dropped from state with no coverage gap. When they reappear, their `since` resets and they are diagnosed again as "new".
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:103, 1012-1056; scripts/check_issue_pr_audit_report.py:75-78 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `render_model_input()` truncates input at `MODEL_INPUT_MAX_BYTES = 600_000`, but `required_refs` / `required_report_refs` still demand every deep flagged item and every new blocked item, including items cut off before the model saw them.
  WHY: On heavy days both model attempts fail with `missing_urls > 0`, giving `ISSUE_PR_AUDIT_REPORT outcome=invalid` with no report PR and no state advance. The next window is larger, so the audit stalls. A also notes that the truncation appends a closing `</untrusted_external_data>` tag even when the cut was not inside a wrapped block.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:131-155, 547-617 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The credential-bearing audit steps (collect, deliver, and others) check only `vars.ISSUE_PR_AUDIT_ENABLED` and the schedule or inputs. The `trusted_ref` check in "Resolve AI engine" only decides whether Claude support is staged.
  WHY: A `workflow_dispatch` from an unmerged branch runs that branch's audit scripts with `GH_PAT`/`REPORT_PUSH_TOKEN` (and `AI_COMMENT_SIGNING_SECRET` in delivery), so credentials can be exfiltrated or misused. Severity disagreement: openai_gpt-6-luna said BLOCKER, minimax and z-ai said MAJOR, and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected it explicitly, because a workflow_dispatch needs write access and a writer can already edit the workflow.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:93-159 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `id-token: write` was added at job level to the collect-logs job (lines 102-107).
  WHY: It widens the attack surface and the OIDC impersonation risk for the whole job if any step is compromised or leaks. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this: the permission is required for the Claude pool, and the model subshell unsets `ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_*`.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:991-1003 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Repository-controlled labels, PR head refs and the `stats` line are put into the model prompt as plain text instead of going through `wrap_untrusted()`.
  WHY: Instructions injected through a label or branch name can shape the generated report, and that report is delivered through a generated-chore path that skips the reviewer panel.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:532-545 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: "Install Claude Code CLI" and "Resolve Claude credential" use the implicit `success()` gate, while the model pass and the codex setup use `!cancelled()`.
  WHY: After any earlier collect-logs failure, the model pass runs with no Claude CLI or credential. A non-75 rc returns "refused" (76) or fails without a codex fallback, so the day ends `ISSUE_PR_AUDIT_REPORT outcome=invalid`. All three reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:1109-1116; scripts/issue_pr_audit_run.sh:337-351 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `state_update()` sets `last_tg_date = today` before any Telegram send happens, and `ipa_telegram` saves the per-day cache marker when `sent > 0` even if other parts failed.
  WHY: Same-day retries are suppressed (`already_sent_today` / cache hit) even when nothing, or only some parts, were delivered. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 said NIT; the others said MAJOR.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit_run.sh:248-263 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `ipa_deliver` builds `analysis/issue_pr_audit_state.json` from default-branch HEAD on a fresh branch, while `workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh` only logs `INFO: earlier_report_open=true` when an earlier report PR is open.
  WHY: Two open report PRs both add or modify the state file. The second gets an add/add or content conflict, and the conflict resolver may move cursors backwards or drop blocked entries with their `since` history.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:397-413 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `list_window` sets `partial_cursor` only `if truncated and repo.get("has_issues", True) and items`, so a capped PR listing for a `has_issues=false` repository leaves no partial cursor.
  WHY: `next_cursor` falls back to the run start, so PRs beyond `max_window_pages` are permanently skipped. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected "pagination caps on the window listing" in general, saying the listing is cursor-resumed and marked truncated.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:351-355, 589-590 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `closed_unmerged_pr` relies on `merged_at` from the `/issues` listing's `pull_request` object, which these reviewers say is never populated, and the GraphQL `MergedEvent` is not used to backfill it.
  WHY: Every merged PR would be flagged as `closed_unmerged_pr` waste and use up deep-review slots. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this: the REST issues listing's `pull_request` object does carry `merged_at`, and `normalize_item` reads it.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:357-374, 583, 630-631 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `failure_label_at_close` tests the item's current labels instead of the label set at closure.
  WHY: Removing an `ai:*-failed` label after closure hides a real failure, and adding one after closure creates a false waste signal.
- scripts/check_issue_pr_audit_report.py:75-100 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The validator's `required_refs` / `check` require only deep flagged items and new blocked items, not known blocked items or clean-sample items (report contract in `prompts/mode-issue-pr-audit.txt` lines 24-32).
  WHY: A report that omits the known blocked items or the clean-sample verdicts still passes and is delivered through the skip-review path. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this as matching the issue's checker contract.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:569-575, 871-873 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `in_window` accepts only items with a recent `created_at`/`closed_at`/`merged_at`, so an item reopened in the window and still open never reaches `waste_signals`.
  WHY: The documented `reopened` tier-1 signal can never fire for such items.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:595-603, 870 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `duplicate_title` peers are only the current window plus the open snapshot, so a duplicate created within 7 days but last updated before the cursor is invisible.
  WHY: The signal underfires in the common case of an issue that was opened and then closed before the cursor.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:796-801, 821-833 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The heal listing reads only one page (`paginate(... "labels=ai:workflow-heal", 1)`), and `prior_aud_titles` reads only `reports[-1]`.
  WHY: With more than 100 open heal issues, or with plans in older reports, the model lacks the dedupe inputs and plans causes that are already planned again.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:283-294, 384-419 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `paginate` enforces only `max_pages` (10 for the window, 5 for the open listing) and silently truncates high-activity repositories, with no total-item guard.
  WHY: High-activity repositories lose blocked items past the snapshot cap and old window items past the listing cap.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:306-310, 910-913 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: When `discover_repos` falls back to the host repository after a listing failure, `classify` keeps old blocked entries only for repositories in `failed_displays`, so stored blocked items for other repositories are dropped.
  WHY: A transient `/user/repos` failure erases other repositories' blocked state, so items are treated as new afterwards and their age and history are lost.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:232-246 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The API counter is incremented before the retry loop, so it counts one call per retry sequence instead of one per attempt.
  WHY: The Metrics Appendix underreports API calls when requests are retried.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit_run.sh:ipa_collect (classify / render-input calls) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Under `set -euo pipefail`, an exception in `classify` or `render-input` is not handled the way collect failures are (`ISSUE_PR_AUDIT_SKIPPED reason=collect_failed`, return 0).
  WHY: Any tier-1 Python exception fails the daily collect-logs job, which contradicts the script header's contract that every subcommand returns 0 for handled outcomes.
- scripts/stage_switches.json:916-920 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The unrelated `HEAL_COUNTERFACTUAL_HOLD_EXPIRY_ENABLED` entry, which belongs to op
